_readme: WHAT'S NEW - the update cards on the home page.
HOW THE SECTION IS BUILT
The newest past-paper card is NOT written here. It is generated at build
time from data/papers.json: the build finds the most recent published
year, counts the papers and names the grades. Add a paper and the card
updates itself. Nothing to edit.
The entries below are for things that are not in any other data file -
a new section of the site, a new course, a new book. They are merged with
the generated paper card, sorted by date, newest first, and the home page
shows the first six.
FIELDS
id           short name, no spaces
date         2026-08-28. Sorting and the NEW label both use this.
title        what the card says
description  ONE sentence. Two makes the card too tall.
url          a page on this site. The build fails if it does not exist,
so a broken card cannot reach the website.
linkLabel    Explore | View details   (default: Explore)
published    false hides the card without deleting the record
THE NEW LABEL
Added automatically to any entry dated within 90 days of the newest
entry. Nothing to set by hand, and it fades out on its own.
NEVER add an entry pointing at an unpublished resource, or at a Google
Drive file whose sharing is not 'Anyone with the link - Viewer'.
After editing this file, run build.cmd.

items.title: RCF Target Paper 1, with the answer key
items.description: A complete O/L English Language paper written by RCF English - Papers I and II, sixteen tests - following the 2026 examination model. The answer key is published with it. Free to download.

items.title: General English 2026: answers to both papers
items.description: RCF English's answers to every question in the 2026 A/L General English paper, Paper I and Paper II, with full model answers for the two writing questions. Free to download.

items.title: Every competency level, Grades 6 to 11
items.description: The eight English Language competencies and all the competency levels for each grade, transcribed from the NIE Teachers' Guides, for your lesson plans, term plans and SBA tools.

items.title: Pupil's Books and Teachers' Guides, free to download
items.description: Every English book and Teachers' Guide the government publishes free, Grades 1 to 13, with a direct download for each. Where the department's server is slow, the download comes from the RCF English Drive instead.

items.title: 113 sample PPP lesson plans, Grades 3 to 13
items.description: Ready-to-teach Presentation, Practice and Production lessons built on the unit activities of the government Pupil's Books, with timings for a 40-minute period. Each page can be downloaded as an editable Word document or a print-ready PDF.

items.title: Annual, term, daily and weekly planning templates
items.description: A yearly scheme of work and a term plan with each grade's units already listed, and record-of-work forms with a filled-in example for every grade from 2 to 13.

items.title: Twenty sample SBA tools, with rubrics
items.description: School Based Assessment tools for English from the primary grades to A/L, and five for O/L English Literature, each set out in the usual assessment tool format with its marking criteria and one tool to a page.

items.title: Six school project proposals you can adapt
items.description: English Only Day, English Day, a class reading programme, a wall newspaper, an English Literary Association, and a spelling bee and quiz, each in the same simple format to hand to your principal.

items.title: Sixty worksheets, Grades 6 to 11
items.description: Ten printable worksheets for every grade from 6 to 11, covering reading, writing and grammar, each with an answer key and written by RCF English.

items.title: Primary English
items.description: A whole new section for younger children: alphabet practice, ten-minute activities, poems, short reading passages and games that mark themselves.

items.title: Seven new interactive activities
items.description: Letter sounds, first words, rhyming, word meanings, sentence order and a reading passage, each one marking itself and explaining every answer.

items.title: Grade 5 Scholarship English
items.description: English-medium language practice for scholarship candidates, with an honest account of the part of the examination this site can help with.

items.title: Literature Orientation: One-Month Course for New Teachers
items.description: A one-month online course for teachers new to English Literature: planning a lesson, teaching a poem, a story and a play, and marking written answers usefully.

items.title: Grade 9 and Grade 10 English Literature classes
items.description: Two of the four Student Classes at RCF Online Academy, taking a student from first close reading through to the Ordinary Level texts.

items.title: O/L and A/L Literature classes
items.description: Examination-year Literature taught online: texts studied in full, answers written under timed conditions and every piece corrected individually.

items.title: RCF Publications
items.description: The support books and study guides written by Rohana Fernando, sold separately through the RCF Publications bookshop.

items.title: Teacher Resources
items.description: Lesson plans, worksheets, marking guides and practical classroom support, gathered in one place for teachers of English and Literature.
